Yes. No ads, no accounts and no upgrade later.
Does it send my files or data anywhere?
No. The app has no network code. It only moves files inside your Downloads folder.
macOS says it can’t verify the app. What now?

On macOS 15 or later, click Done (not Move to Trash), open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to Security and click Open Anyway next to Sortly. On macOS 13 and 14, right-click the app, choose Open, then Open again. You only need to do this once.
Does it work on an Intel Mac?
Not yet. This version is built for Apple Silicon (M1 and newer).
Files are moved, not deleted. Open the sub-folder inside Downloads and drag the file back. Use Pause Sorting in the menu if you want files to stay put.
Does it work with torrent clients?
Not well. Don’t point a torrent client at your Downloads folder. The app moves finished files, and the client may then report them missing and stop seeding.
Choose Quit from the menu bar icon, then drag the app from Applications to the Trash. Folders it already made in Downloads stay.
